disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict using DMTF field definitions: Error Type/Granularity/Operation, Vendor Syndrome, Memory Array/Device Address and Resolution are Type 18; Manufacturer, chassis Type/Version/Serial/Asset and Boot-up/Power/Thermal/Security status are Type 3. Both branches stay mandatory. All matrices and evidence are independently bound to this exact code/variant/recipe; row 1935 cannot substitute. Reboot parameters are Project Configuration and logs remain preserved.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1947, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, distinct row-1935 Type 18 record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 1957 / Wistron-AMD SVM-00037-V003 / 64487bf0e8a41c39.
DMTF maps every mixed field deterministically to Type 18 or Type 3; neither branch is deleted.
The distinct code and source row require an exact Wistron-BIOS-00488-V002 recipe, memory topology, target identity and independent raw execution artifacts even if parser logic is shared.
Complete structures, handles and all payload fields with stdout/stderr/status are required; a header grep or row-1935 evidence cannot pass.
One approved OS warm reboot requires same-target Boot ID and OS Ready proof; baseline logs are preserved instead of cleared.
No dmidecode, SSH, reboot, log-clear, firmware, SMBIOS, security or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Exact-target SMBIOS Type 18 memory-error and Type 3 chassis persistence
test_case.purpose: Validate complete Type 18 memory-error metadata and listed Type 3 chassis identity/status fields for exact Wistron-BIOS-00488-V002 before and after one approved reboot, with no evidence substitution from similar rows.
required_package: Exact Wistron-BIOS-00488-V002 SUT/board/memory/BIOS/SMBIOS identity and versioned Type 18 plus Type 3 matrices
Validated dmidecode and complete Type 18/3 parser preserving handles, multiplicity, raw output, stderr/status and protected addresses/identity data
Secure authenticated access and independent evidence namespace proving this Source Key/variant
Approved OS warm reboot/window/Boot ID timeout and console/BMC recovery
Preserved dmesg/syslog/SEL and explicit row-1935 non-substitution audit
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY COLLECTION AROUND ONE APPROVED REBOOT; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind exact code/variant/target/recipe and preserve logs. Securely collect complete `dmidecode --type 18` and `--type 3` output/status without grep. Compare every Type 18 error field and listed Type 3 field with exact-target matrices. After one approved OS warm reboot, prove same-target Boot ID change and OS Ready, then repeat and semantic-diff. Store artifacts under this variant only. Do not reuse row-1935 evidence, clear logs, expose credentials, alter firmware/SMBIOS/security or retry.
test_case.expected_result: Every expected exact-target Type 18 record contains correct error type, granularity, operation, syndrome, addresses and resolution, and Type 3 contains correct identity/status/security values. Both complete sets remain semantically correct and stable after OS Ready with no unexplained health regression.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact-target identity, complete successful pre/post Type 18/3 evidence, every field/multiplicity correct, approved Boot ID-changing reboot and OS Ready. FAIL on wrong/cross-row target, missing/extra/malformed structure, field/address mismatch, unexpected persistence change or reboot/health failure. NOT READY covers absent matrices/access/recovery. Header grep or row-1935 artifacts cannot PASS; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Read-only only; never alter firmware, SMBIOS, chassis security or memory state.
Preserve logs/raw output and protect addresses, serials, assets and security metadata; never clear or suppress errors.
Use secure verified access and approved reboot/recovery; no insecure credentials/host verification.
Stop on target drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry or cross-row evidence reuse.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/code/recipe and target/BIOS/SMBIOS/dmidecode/parser identities plus exact-target matrices
Complete pre/post Type 18 and Type 3 raw/parsed output/status and protected hashes
All error/address/resolution and chassis identity/status comparisons
Approved reboot timeline, Boot IDs, same-target OS Ready and preserved logs/health
Explicit row-1935 non-substitution plus no-clear/no-write/no-retry audit and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On reboot failure preserve the first exact-target evidence and use only approved console/BMC recovery. On missing or changed Type 18/3 data, preserve full SMBIOS tables and firmware/memory identity, make no BIOS/SMBIOS/security edit and escalate. Never replace the failure with row-1935 evidence or an automatic rerun.
